developerExport.layoutRule: Translate Auto Layout, FILL/HUG sizing, constraints and wrapping into the responsive layout primitives of the target framework instead of defaulting to absolute positioning.
developerExport.assetRule: Prefer SVG for implementation fidelity; use the matching PNG copy for quick visual inspection and QA. Prefer composed SVGs for decorative multi-vector groups.
developerExport.designSystemRule: Promote recurring colors, typography, radii, spacing and reusable UI patterns into the target project’s centralized design system/tokens.
